ayahs.1: Tamaam taareefen us Allah ke liye sazaawaar hain jis ki milkiyat mein woh sab kuchh hai jo aasmanon aur zameen mein hai. Aakhirat mein bhi taareef isi ke liye hai, woh (badi) hikmaton wala aur (poora) khabardaar hai.
ayahs.2: Jo zameen mein jaaye aur jo us se nikle, jo aasman se utre aur jo chadh kar us mein jaaye woh sab se ba-khabar hai. Aur woh mehrbaan nihayat bakhshish wala hai.
ayahs.3: Kuffar kehte hain ke hum par qayamat nahin aayegi. Aap keh dijiye! Ke mujhe mere Rabb ki qasam! Jo Aalim-ul-Ghaib hai ke woh yaqeenan tum par aayegi. Allah Taala se ek zarre ke baraabar ki cheez bhi posheeda nahin, na aasmanon mein aur na zameen mein, balke is se bhi chhoti aur badi cheez khuli kitaab mein maujood hai.
ayahs.4: Taake woh imaan walon aur nekokaaron ko bhalai ata farmaaye, yehi log hain jin ke liye maghfirat aur izzat ki rozi hai.
ayahs.5: Aur hamari aayaton ko neecha dikhaane ki jinhon ne koshish ki hai yeh woh log hain jin ke liye badtareen qism ka dardnaak azaab hai.
ayahs.6: Aur jinhein ilm hai woh dekh lenge ke jo kuchh aap ki janib aap ke Rabb ki taraf se naazil hua hai woh (sarasar) haq hai aur Allah ghaalib khoobiyon wale ki raah ki rehberi karta hai.
ayahs.7: Aur kaafiron ne kaha (aao) hum tumhein ek aisa shakhs batlaayen jo tumhein yeh khabar pahuncha raha hai ke jab tum bilkul hi reza reza ho jaaoge to tum phir se ek nai paidaish mein aaoge.
ayahs.8: (Hum nahin keh sakte) ke khud us ne (hi) Allah par jhooth baandh liya hai ya use deewangi hai, balke (haqeeqat yeh hai) ke aakhirat par yaqeen na rakhne wale hi azaab mein aur door ki gumraahi mein hain.
ayahs.9: Kya pas woh apne aage peechhe aasman-o-zameen ko dekh nahin rahe hain? Agar hum chaahen to unhein zameen mein dhansa dein ya un par aasman ke tukde gira dein, yaqeenan is mein poori daleel hai har us bande ke liye jo (dil se) mutawajjah ho.
ayahs.10: Aur hum ne Daaood par apna fazl kiya, ae pahaado! Us ke saath raghbat se tasbeeh padha karo aur parindon ko bhi (yehi hukm hai) aur hum ne us ke liye loha narm kar diya.
ayahs.11: Ke tu poori poori zirhen bana aur jodon mein andaaza rakh, tum sab nek kaam kiya karo. (Yaqeen maano) ke main tumhare aamaal dekh raha hoon.
ayahs.12: Aur hum ne Sulaiman ke liye hawa ko musakhkhar kar diya ke subah ki manzil us ki maheena bhar ki hoti thi aur shaam ki manzil bhi, aur hum ne un ke liye taambe ka chashma baha diya. Aur us ke Rabb ke hukm se baaz jinnat us ki maatihati mein us ke saamne kaam karte the aur un mein se jo bhi hamare hukm se sartabi kare hum use bhadakti hui aag ke azaab ka maza chakhaayenge.
ayahs.13: Jo kuchh Sulaiman chaahte woh jinnat tayyar kar dete, masalan qile aur mujassame aur hauzon ke baraabar lagan aur choolhon par jami hui mazboot degen, ae aal-e-Daaood is ke shukriya mein nek amal karo, mere bandon mein se shukr-guzar bande kam hi hote hain.
ayahs.14: Phir jab hum ne un par maut ka hukm bhej diya to un ki khabar jinnat ko kisi ne na di siwaaye ghun ke keede ke jo un ke asa ko kha raha tha. Pas jab (Sulaiman) gir pade us waqt jinnon ne jaan liya ke agar woh ghaib-daan hote to is ke zillat ke azaab mein mubtala na rehte.
ayahs.15: Qaum-e-Saba ke liye apni bastiyon mein (qudrat-e-Ilahi ki) nishani thi, un ke daayen baayen do baagh the, (hum ne un ko hukm diya tha ke) apne Rabb ki di hui rozi khaao aur us ka shukr ada karo, yeh umda shehar aur woh bakhshne wala Rabb hai.
ayahs.16: Lekin unhon ne rogardaani ki to hum ne un par zor ke sailaab (ka paani) bhej diya aur hum ne un ke (hare bhare) baaghon ke badle do (aise) baagh diye jo badmaza mewon wale aur (ba-kasrat) jhaao aur kuchh beri ke darakhton wale the.
ayahs.17: Hum ne un ki na-shukri ka yeh badla unhein diya. Hum (aisi) sakht saza bade bade na-shukron hi ko dete hain.
ayahs.18: Aur hum ne un ke aur un bastiyon ke darmiyaan jin mein hum ne barkat de rakhi thi chand bastiyan aur (aabaad) rakhi thin jo barsar-e-raah zaahir thin, aur un mein chalne ki manzilen muqarrar kar di thin. Un mein raaton aur dinon ko ba-aman-o-amaan chalte phirte raho.
ayahs.19: Lekin unhon ne phir kaha ke ae hamare Parwardigaar! Hamare safar door-daraaz kar de. Chunke khud unhon ne apne haathon apna bura kiya is liye hum ne unhein (guzashta) fasaanon ki soorat mein kar diya aur un ke tukde tukde uda diye. Bila-shubha har ek sabr-o-shukr karne wale ke liye is (maajre) mein bahut si ibraten hain.
ayahs.20: Aur shaitaan ne un ke baare mein apna gumaan sachcha kar dikhaaya, yeh log sab ke sab us ke taabedaar ban gaye siwaaye mominon ki ek jamaat ke.
ayahs.21: Shaitaan ka un par koi zor (aur dabao) na tha magar is liye ke hum un logon ko jo aakhirat par imaan rakhte hain zaahir kar dein un logon mein se jo is se shak mein hain. Aur aap ka Rabb (har) har cheez par nigehbaan hai.
ayahs.22: Keh dijiye! Ke Allah ke siwa jin jin ka tumhein gumaan hai (sab) ko pukaar lo, na un mein se kisi ko aasmanon aur zameenon mein se ek zarre ka ikhtiyaar hai, na un ka in mein koi hissa hai, na un mein se koi Allah ka madadgaar hai.
ayahs.23: Shafaa'at (sifaarish) bhi us ke paas kuchh nafa nahin deti bajuz un ke jin ke liye ijaazat ho jaaye. Yahan tak ke jab un ke dilon se ghabraahat door kar di jaati hai to poochhte hain tumhare Parwardigaar ne kya farmaaya? Jawab dete hain ke haq farmaaya aur woh buland-o-baala aur bahut bada hai.
ayahs.24: Poochhiye ke tumhein aasmanon aur zameen se rozi kaun pahunchaata hai? (Khud) jawab dijiye! Ke Allah Taala. (Suno) hum ya tum, ya to yaqeenan hidayat par hain ya khuli gumraahi mein hain?
ayahs.25: Keh dijiye! Ke hamare kiye hue gunahon ki baabat tum se koi sawaal na kiya jaayega, na tumhare aamaal ki baaz-purs hum se ki jaayegi.
ayahs.26: Unhein khabar de dijiye ke hum sab ko hamara Rabb jama karke phir hum mein sachche faisle kar dega. Woh faisle chukaane wala hai aur daana.
ayahs.27: Keh dijiye! Ke achchha mujhe bhi to unhein dikha do jinhein tum Allah ka shareek thahra kar us ke saath mila rahe ho, aisa hargiz nahin, balke wahi Allah hai ghaalib ba-hikmat.
ayahs.28: Hum ne aap ko tamaam logon ke liye khushkhabriyan sunaane wala aur daraane wala bana kar bheja hai, haan magar (yeh saheeh hai) ke logon ki aksariyat be-ilm hai.
ayahs.29: Poochhte hain ke woh waada hai kab? Sachche ho to bata do.
ayahs.30: Jawab dijiye ke waade ka din theek muayyan hai jis se ek saa'at na tum peechhe hat sakte ho na aage badh sakte ho.
ayahs.31: Aur kaafiron ne kaha ke hum hargiz na to is Quran ko maanen na is se pehle ki kitaabon ko! Ae dekhne wale kaash ke tu un zaalimon ko is waqt dekhta jabke yeh apne Rabb ke saamne khade hue ek doosre ko ilzaam de rahe honge. Kamzor log bade logon se kahenge agar tum na hote to hum to momin hote.
ayahs.32: Yeh bade log un kamzoron ko jawab denge ke kya tumhare paas hidayat aa chukne ke baad hum ne tumhein is se roka tha? (Nahin) balke tum (khud) hi mujrim the.
ayahs.33: (Is ke jawab mein) yeh kamzor log un mutakabbiron se kahenge, (nahin nahin) balke din raat makr-o-fareb se hamein Allah ke saath kufr karne aur us ke shareek muqarrar karne ka tumhara hukm dena hamari be-imaani ka baais hua, aur azaab ko dekhte hi sab ke sab dil mein pashemaan ho rahe honge, aur kaafiron ki gardanon mein hum tauq daal denge. Unhein sirf un ke kiye karaaye aamaal ka badla diya jaayega.
ayahs.34: Aur hum to jis basti mein jo bhi aagaah karne wala bheja wahan ke khushhaal logon ne yehi kaha ke jis cheez ke saath tum bheje gaye ho hum us ke saath kufr karne wale hain.
ayahs.35: Aur kaha hum maal-o-aulaad mein bahut badhe hue hain, yeh nahin ho sakta ke hum azaab diye jaayen.
ayahs.36: Keh dijiye! Ke mera Rabb jis ke liye chaahe rozi kushaada kar deta hai aur tang bhi kar deta hai, lekin aksar log nahin jaante.
ayahs.37: Aur tumhare maal aur aulaad aise nahin ke tumhein hamare paas (martabon se) qareeb kar dein, haan jo imaan laayen aur nek amal karen un ke liye un ke aamaal ka dohra ajr hai aur woh nidar-o-be-khauf ho kar baala-khaanon mein rahenge.
ayahs.38: Aur jo log hamari aayaton ke muqaable ki tag-o-do mein lage rehte hain yehi hain jo azaab mein pakad kar haazir rakhe jaayenge.
ayahs.39: Keh dijiye! Ke mera Rabb apne bandon mein jis ke liye chaahe rozi kushaada karta hai aur jis ke liye chaahe tang kar deta hai, tum jo kuchh bhi Allah ki raah mein kharch karoge Allah is ka (poora poora) badla dega aur woh sab se behtar rozi dene wala hai.
ayahs.40: Aur un sab ko Allah is din jama karke farishton se daryaft farmaayega ke kya yeh log tumhari ibaadat karte the.
ayahs.41: Woh kahenge teri zaat paak hai aur hamara wali to tu hai na ke yeh, balke yeh log jinnon ki ibaadat karte the, un mein ke aksar ka un hi par imaan tha.
ayahs.42: Pas aaj tum mein se koi (bhi) kisi ke liye (bhi kisi qism ke) nafa nuqsaan ka maalik na hoga. Aur hum zaalimon se keh denge ke is aag ka azaab chakho jise tum jhutlaate rahe.
ayahs.43: Aur jab un ke saamne hamari saaf saaf aayaten padhi jaati hain to kehte hain ke yeh aisa shakhs hai jo tumhein tumhare baap-daada ke maboodon se rok dena chaahta hai. (Is ke siwa koi baat nahin), aur kehte hain ke yeh to ghada hua jhooth hai aur haq un ke paas aa chuka phir bhi kaafir yehi kehte rahe ke yeh to khula hua jaadu hai.
ayahs.44: Aur un (Makka walon) ko na to hum ne kitaaben de rakhi hain jinhein yeh padhte hon na un ke paas aap se pehle koi aagaah karne wala aaya.
ayahs.45: Aur un se pehle ke logon ne bhi hamari baaton ko jhutlaaya tha aur unhein hum ne jo de rakha tha yeh to is ke daswein hisse ko bhi nahin pahunche, pas unhon ne mere Rasoolon ko jhutlaaya, (phir dekh ke) mera azaab kaisa (sakht) tha.
ayahs.46: Keh dijiye! Ke main tumhein sirf ek hi baat ki naseehat karta hoon ke tum Allah ke waaste (zid chhod kar) do do mil kar ya tanha tanha khade ho kar socho to sahi, tumhare is rafeeq ko koi junoon nahin, woh to tumhein ek bade (sakht) azaab ke aane se pehle daraane wala hai.
ayahs.47: Keh dijiye! Ke jo badla main tum se maangoon woh tumhare liye hai, mera badla to Allah Taala hi ke zimme hai. Woh har cheez se ba-khabar (aur muttala) hai.
ayahs.48: Keh dijiye! Ke mera Rabb haq (sachchi wahi) naazil farmaata hai, woh har ghaib ka jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.49: Keh dijiye ke haq aa chuka, baatil na to pehle kuchh kar saka hai aur na kar sakega.
ayahs.50: Keh dijiye ke agar main behak jaaoon to mere behakne (ka wabaal) mujh par hi hai aur agar main raah-e-hidaayat par hoon to ba-sabab is wahi ke jo mera Parwardigaar mujhe karta hai, woh bada hi sunne wala aur bahut hi qareeb hai.
ayahs.51: Aur agar aap (woh waqt) mulaahiza karen jabke yeh kuffar ghabraaye phirenge, phir nikal bhaagne ki koi soorat na hogi aur qareeb ki jagah se giraftaar kar liye jaayenge.
ayahs.52: Is waqt kahenge ke hum is Quran par imaan laaye lekin is qadar door jagah se (matloob cheez) kaise haath aa sakti hai.
ayahs.53: Is se pehle to unhon ne is se kufr kiya tha, aur door-daraaz se bin dekhe hi phenkte rahe.
ayahs.54: Un ki chaahaton aur un ke darmiyaan parda haail kar diya gaya jaise ke is se pehle bhi un jaison ke saath kiya gaya, woh bhi (un hi ki tarah) shak-o-taraddud mein (pade hue) the.
